body.statement: Suppose \(\mathcal Q^r(P)\ne\varnothing\) and no restriction beyond membership in \(\mathcal Q^r(P)\) couples distinct potential-outcome arms. Conditional product coupling of separately chosen arm kernels preserves the observed factual law, every armwise score restriction, and every aggregate support. Therefore the sharp ATE closure for \(\Delta_{d,e}\) is exactly \(\mathcal I_{\Delta}^r(P)\).
body.justification: Marginal sharpness does not by itself establish that two arms attain opposite endpoints on one full-data law.
body.gap: Park2025 proves joint attainment under MIV plus MTR; no checked result supplies the conditional product witness under armwise SDC and exact aggregate support.
body.consumer: The proposition justifies reporting ATE differences of eligible arm intervals rather than an unverified subtraction of marginal outer bounds.
